D.t: Sanford Bishop leads by 29.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 98,766 votes; a one point swing is about 1,675 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +20.2 and D +38.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
